title: Add VPC control plane Terraform: multi-AZ subnets, interface endpoints, SGs, peering, Route53
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: Support fully automated VPC provisioning for the Private Control Plane across multiple AZs with secure interface endpoints, narrow security groups, optional cross-account peering, and Route53 private hosted zone peering. This PR adds a reusable Terraform module and example that mirrors production topology so customers can deploy the private control plane in their accounts or across accounts for cross-account setups. Key changes: new modules/vpc main.tf/variables/outputs covering multi-az subnet creation, public/private subnet naming conventions, NAT gateway optionality, interface and gateway endpoints (SSM, EC2, KMS, ECR, STS), dedicated control-plane security group with least-privilege rules, optional cross-account VPC peering resources and route propagation, Route53 private hosted zone creation + conditional peering to an operator-owned hosted zone, example configs under examples/control-plane/multi-az, Helm values tweaks to wire in new endpoint hostnames for the installer, and upgrade hooks to perform DNS sync during rolling upgrades. Checklist: - [x] Terraform module implemented and documented - [x] Example multi-AZ deployment added - [x] Helm chart values updated and back-compat preserved - [x] Unit and integration tests for module (terraform validate + terratest locally) - [x] CI passes for linting and plan approval How to review: focus on variables and sensible defaults, cross-account ACLs, and documented operator steps for peering acceptance. This description is a single continuous string and links to Linear ticket ENG-4819 and support ticket SUP-9123.
commits: module(vpc): add multi-az subnet and nat gateway support
module(vpc): add interface endpoints and endpoint security group rules
examples: add control-plane/multi-az example with variables and README

docs: add vpc-provisioning and upgrade hook instructions
tests: add terratest harness for example deployment
review_comments: Ben Carter: Please double-check the default CIDR sizing to avoid conflicts with typical corporate ranges. Consider making the CIDR a required variable for orgs with strict addressing.
Asha Patel: Good catch, Ben. I changed default to 10.42.0.0/16 and made cidr_block an explicit variable in the example. Updated README to highlight this.
Liu Zhang: The security group rules look tight but the ECR endpoints may need an explicit egress rule to S3 for image pulls in some regions. Can we add a note?
Asha Patel: Added conditional egress to S3 when enable_ecr_repo_sync is true and documented fallback for regions without gateway endpoints.

Maya Singh: CI plan shows a potential issue with the peering acceptance step being manual. We should document cross-account acceptance and provide an automated CloudFormation acceptor as an optional module.
Asha Patel: Added peering-policy.md with operator steps and an optional peering-acceptor module. Kept manual acceptance as default to avoid accidental cross-account modifications.
Ben Carter: Approving after confirming Terraform fmt and validate in CI.
Liu Zhang: Approved with minor comments addressed.
release_notes: Adds a Terraform module and example to provision multi-AZ VPCs for the Private Control Plane, including interface endpoints, secure security groups, optional cross-account VPC peering, and Route53 private hosted zone peering. Includes Helm values updates and upgrade hooks for DNS synchronization.
